title: Peopleless economy? Not technically impossible
summary: A philosophical and technical exploration examining whether a fully automated economy operating without human labor is theoretically achievable, given advances in AI and automation technologies. The article analyzes the technical feasibility and implications of a post-human economic system.
problem_solved: Examines whether an economy can function entirely without human participation through automation and AI
why_valuable: Provides critical analysis of AI's potential to fundamentally reshape economic systems and human role in production
